informal_statement:
For every
\[
0<h\leq1,
\]
the support difference multiplied by \(h\) equals \(J(h)\), and
\[
h^2[A_4(h)-A_3(h)]=H(h).
\]
Moreover
\[
A_4(h)-A_3(h)\geq\gamma_\lambda/h^2>0
\]
and
\[
[P_4(h)-hA_4(h)]-[P_3(h)-hA_3(h)]\geq\gamma_\lambda/h>0.
\]
